projects.label: — SELECTED PROJECTS / 2025–2026
projects.subtitle: Some of what I've built so far.

approach.label: — APPROACH
approach.body: Started coding in May 2025. Now I'm learning fullstack: React, TypeScript, Node and Postgres. Right now the goal is a solid foundation.

aether.description: Landing page experiment. Minimal design, smooth scrolling and a custom cursor.
aether.fullDescription: Landing page for a made-up UI library. Custom cursor, scroll animations and simple type. The first time I tried to make something that actually looked deliberate. I spent most of the time on spacing and rhythm.

2048.description: Classic 2048 in plain JavaScript. Built while I was learning OOP and async code.
2048.fullDescription: Classic 2048 in plain JavaScript, no framework and no libraries. The first project where I had to work out a real algorithm before writing any code. This is where OOP finally clicked for me.

yatzy.description: Full Yatzy game in plain JavaScript. Built in two days for a school assignment, with game logic and DOM kept apart.
yatzy.fullDescription: Yatzy with every scoring rule: yatzy, full house and the rest. Game logic and DOM code live in separate files. It felt like overkill until I had to debug it. Built in two days for school and cleaned up afterwards.

stasis.description: Landing page for a made-up longevity clinic. React 19, Tailwind v4 and Framer Motion.
stasis.fullDescription: Landing page for a made-up longevity clinic. The goal was to make it look expensive. React 19, Tailwind v4 and Framer Motion. Probably the most design-heavy thing I've made.

hdufndsk.description: Awareness site about drunk and drugged driving. Built with a serious topic in mind, not just for looks.
hdufndsk.fullDescription: Awareness site about drunk and drugged driving. It was meant to become a social platform but stayed an experiment. The backend is there, Node and Express, and it's the first API I wrote on my own. Still online, still unfinished.

kropp-fitness.description: My first landing page. Just HTML and CSS. This is where I learned what semantic HTML is.
kropp-fitness.fullDescription: My very first landing page. Just HTML and CSS, not a single line of JavaScript. I didn't know what semantic HTML was when I started. By the end, I did.

skrekkeparken.description: Halloween map game, built as a school project. Leaflet, geolocation and events loaded from JSON.
skrekkeparken.fullDescription: Halloween map game we built at school in a group of four. Leaflet.js for the interactive map, geolocation to track the player and events loaded from JSON. Done in a week.

date-time.description: Wallpaper Engine theme with a live clock and date. Plain JavaScript, the Date API and CSS animations.
date-time.fullDescription: Wallpaper Engine theme with a clock and date that update every second. Plain JavaScript, the Date API and a lot of CSS transitions. Small, but I use it every day.

redbeardvfx.description: Portfolio site for a VFX supervisor. Real client project, already live.
redbeardvfx.fullDescription: Portfolio site for a VFX supervisor. The site is live, and I'm working through the last requirements before handing it over. The first time I built something around someone else's creative vision instead of my own.

todo-react.description: Fullstack task app. React, Node and Express, connected to a real database.
todo-react.fullDescription: Fullstack task app. React on the frontend, Node and Express on the backend, connected to a real database. The first time every piece actually talked to each other from start to finish.

skan-jus.description: Landing page for a made-up Norwegian law firm. Dark theme, gold details and a custom cursor.
skan-jus.fullDescription: Landing page for Skan Jus, a made-up Norwegian law firm. Dark theme, gold details and a custom triangle cursor. Built to practice Tailwind v4 design tokens and custom cursor logic.

norden-verk.description: Landing page for a made-up Norwegian furniture workshop. Hammer-shaped cursor.
norden-verk.fullDescription: Landing page for a made-up Norwegian furniture workshop. The cursor is a hammer that changes shape on hover and click. Smooth scrolling with Lenis, animations with Framer Motion and the Context API for global state.

greenfield-farms.description: Multi-page site for a farm. React Router, Feature-Sliced Design and component tests.
greenfield-farms.fullDescription: Site for a made-up farm with a home page, a visit page and a 404 page in React Router. The first project I structured with Feature-Sliced Design: widgets, pages and shared. Also the first time I wrote component tests.

nordic-market.description: Online store with a Nordic look. Work in progress.
nordic-market.fullDescription: Online store with a Nordic look. Right now I'm planning the data model and how the components fit together.

background.label: — BACKGROUND
background.body:
I'm Amadi Masuev. I'm in Vg2 Information Technology at Porsgrunn videregående skole, Sør campus, where I've chosen to focus on development.

I started programming in May 2025 and build fullstack projects with React and Node.js. Right now I'm learning Next.js and digging deeper into backend.

learning.label: — LEARNING PATH
learning.subtitle: Where I am now, and where I'm headed.

items.title: Understand it before you build it.
items.body: If I copy code I don't understand, I've forgotten it a week later. So I read up first and write after.

items.title: Finish before you start something new.
items.body: I'd rather finish one project and learn what "done" means than start ten and drop them all.

items.title: Names matter.
items.body: Bad variable names are bugs waiting to happen. I keep renaming until the code explains itself.

hero.line2: Short or long, I read everything.
